summary: Byte zeroer: unconditionally clears the byte at this[0] to 0 and returns the this pointer. No static callers are recorded, so the containing object type and the meaning of the cleared byte are unknown.

local_names.result: this pointer returned to the caller

operations.description: Set *this, the byte at offset 0 of the object, to 0.

unresolved: The object type and the meaning of the cleared byte at offset 0 are unknown (no static callers recorded).
